title: Software Development Life Cycle Perspective: A Survey of Benchmarks for Code Large Language Models and Agents
reasoning: The paper is a systematic survey of existing benchmarks for Code Large Language Models (CodeLLMs) and agents, categorized by phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). While it discusses non-functional requirements such as fairness and societal bias (gender, race, income), it does not feature a component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, theology, or spiritual traditions.
